topic.lq30-walked-out.speaker: npc.hist-heartland.helstrom.lq30-kin
topic.lq30-walked-out.prompt: What are you waiting for here?
lines: I wait for Sei-Wan, my kin. He walked out into the basin alone four hours ago, to prove himself to Helstrom's Agaceph, the tribe that rules this city and that we belong to.
The custom of the Agaceph forbids our own to follow a walk-out. The levy will not go, and I may not. It does not apply to an outsider.
He went east from the gate, through the shallows. Vipers live in the roots there. Anyone who walks into the basin may die there. A warning is posted at the gate.
If you go, bring him home alive. If he can walk home himself, let the walk-out be his own.

topic.lq30-the-basin.speaker: npc.hist-heartland.helstrom.levy-warden-01
topic.lq30-the-basin.prompt: Will you stop me going out into the basin?
lines: No. The custom of Helstrom's Agaceph forbids our own to follow a walk-out. It does not apply to an outsider, so I will not stop you.
But know this. Anyone who walks into the basin round Helstrom may die there. A warning is posted at the gate. What lies in the reed roots bites. The bite kills.
The levy will send none of its own after you. If we followed every youth out, no walk-out would be his own.

topic.lq30-come-back.speaker: npc.hist-heartland.helstrom.lq30-youth
topic.lq30-come-back.prompt: Sei-Wan, come home now. Your kin is waiting.
lines: I walked out alone four hours ago, to prove myself to Helstrom's Agaceph. I wanted to walk home on my own feet.
The viper is dead. You are standing here. I cannot say no to you. I will come.
Walk ahead of me. I do not want to be seen coming home like this.
